Comment: Restart PHP-FPM to flush OPcache and activate menutopic patches

commands: echo 'Before restart — verify menutopic lib.php patch is on disk:'
grep -n 'in_set_sectionnum' /app/moodle/course/format/menutopic/lib.php | head -5 || echo 'PATCH NOT FOUND ON DISK'
systemctl is-active php-fpm && echo 'php-fpm: ACTIVE' || echo 'php-fpm: FAILED'
echo 'Reloading Apache to clear its state...'
systemctl reload httpd || systemctl restart httpd
echo '=== Verify patch is active on disk ==='
grep -c 'in_set_sectionnum' /app/moodle/course/format/menutopic/lib.php && echo 'Guard found in lib.php' || echo 'GUARD MISSING'
